title: German Apple Crumble
description: A delicious German-style apple dessert topped with a crunchy almond crumble topping.
instructions: Peel, core, and slice the apples.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, mediteranean almond butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Mix until the apples are evenly coated.
Transfer the apple mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the almond, chewy granola, and all-purpose flour.
Add the crumble mixture to the top of the apple mixture, spreading it evenly.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
